0.3.3.name: Node
0.3.3.description: The Node class is the basis of every widget in CoshUI.

id.description: Sets a unique identifier for the Node.

width.description: Determines the horizontal size of the Node.

height.description: Determines the vertical size of the Node.

margin.description: Sets the space around the Node.

style.description: Holds the style of the Node in the form of a CoshStyling object.

classes.description: Lets users set reusable styles for Nodes.

z_index.description: Determines the render order of a Node.

mouse_filter.description: Sets different filter types for the Node's mouse interaction.

positioning.description: Determines whether a Node will participate in layout calculations or not.

x.description: Only works with positioning set to ABSOLUTE. Sets the Node's x position starting from parent's x position.

y.description: Only works with positioning set to ABSOLUTE. Sets the Node's y position starting from parent's y position.

children.description: A list of that Node's children.

_was_hovered.description: A variable that stores hover state for that specific Node.

_x.description: The real x value that layout calculations and rendering cares about.

_y.description: The real y value that layout calculations and rendering cares about.
